label: Chat Simulator
description: Slack/Discord/iMessage style chat interface. Messages appear one by one with typing indicators. SCRIPTED: pass the full interaction sequence in data.script (see the script field) -- the component performs it itself; embedding it static and animating over it is wrong.

script.label: Scripted timeline: [{"action": "...", "at": seconds, ...}]. Actions: show-typing, show-response {text}, plus base actions move-cursor, click, type {text}, highlight, zoom-to, wait, parallel. Drive the whole exchange through this script.

cursor_targets.label: Named cursor positions for move-cursor/click in 0-1 component coords.

script_actions.description: Type a message into the chat input
Click the send button or other UI elements
Display an AI or bot response message
